messages:
emma: quick heads-up — bringing up lumen-v1 q4 on staging and noticed a regression focused on Japanese + Arabic mixed inputs. small summary:
- fp32 BLEU: 32.1 chrF: 58.2
- q8 BLEU: 31.9 chrF: 57.9
- q4 BLEU: 26.4 chrF: 52.0 (mixed-jp-ar subset)

emma: small repro input I used (visible):
```
こんにちは — مرحبا (世界)
```

emma: fp32 decode: "こんにちは — مرحبا (世界)"
emma: q4 decode: ")こんにちは( — مرحبا ]世界["  (paren mirrored, stray control/ZW* bytes, CJK bracket order flipped)

ta0: did we change tokenizers pre-normalize in q4 bundle? last time a unicode lib bump flipped NFKC ordering and caused bracket pairing to break. i'll diff tokenizer metadata. @yuki can you run sentencepiece vs tokenizers? :mag:

yuki: quick token dumps:
- sentencepiece: ['こんにちは', ' ', '', ' ', 'مرحبا', ' ', '(', '世界', ')']
- tokenizers (q4): ['(', '\u200b', 'こん', 'にちは', ')', ' ', ' — ', ' ', 'مرح', '\u200c', 'با', ' ', '[', '\u200b', '世界', ']']
(note: inserted ZWSP/ZWNJ around locale boundaries and split within Japanese word)

amir: fyi the q4 runtime includes chunked-emit + fused-kv kernels. i can run with `--no-chunked-emit --dump-tokens` to see if it's a runtime emit issue. will test now.

eval-bot: CI check https://ci.redwood/run/9999 -> regression flagged on multilingual/mixed-jp-ar (delta BLEU -5.5). attached samples at artifacts/9999/mixed-jp-ar.jsonl

yuki: gist with token dumps & small repro: https://gist.github.com/yuki/lumen-jpar-repro. sentencepiece roundtrips fine; tokenizers bundle used in q4 inserts zero-width markers in a few repro cases.

amir: ran kernel-disabled path: tokens match fp32. with chunked-emit enabled the decode buffer shows bytes 0xE2 0x80 0x8B at chunk boundaries which postprocess maps to U+200B. bisecting chunked-emit now.

emma: action items: 1) @tao diff tokenizer.json & unicode flags between q8/q4, 2) @yuki run full mixed-jp-ar subset and post token diffs, 3) @amir bisect chunked-emit kernel and try local revert, 4) i'll open INF-1721 and pin CI samples + gist. if it's tokenization-only we patch tokenizer; if runtime-only we revert chunked-emit on q4 canary.

ta0: found q4 bundle shipped tokenizers with pre-normalize=false. pushing small branch `force-nfkc-pre` to test.

yuki: testing branch now against 200-sample mixed subset; quick run shows BLEU recovers by ~3.0 but not fully. posting full results to the issue soon.

amir: bisect update: chunked-emit commit `c3f9b2` correlates with inserted bytes. local revert fixes decode but adds ~2% p95 latency. will prep emergency revert if PR fix isn't ready.

emma: thanks all. keep updates concise here. i'll summarize root cause & mitigation in INF-1721 when we have conclusive repro. :thumbsup:
